Density measurement test on LSM soil (Mixture of RC and Air-Floated Clay) at relative density approx 0.7; apparatus: lawn roller; loading: rolling each layer six times; cardboard covering. Recorded: average relative density after rolling.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: tool, bin or mold, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
